note: This file is a pure configuration file with no callable functions, classes, or methods. It defines dataset settings, image normalization config, train/test pipelines, and evaluation config for ImageNet pretraining with CLIP-style 448px images. No CLI-invocable code is present.
dataset_type: ImageNet dataset type setting for MMPreTrain-style configs
img_norm_cfg: Image normalization config using CLIP ImageNet mean/std values scaled to 0-255 range
image_size: Image resolution set to 448x448 pixels for CLIP-style pretraining
train_pipeline: Training data augmentation pipeline with RandomResizedCrop, RandomFlip, RandomErasing, Normalize, and tensor conversion
test_pipeline: Test/val pipeline with Resize, CenterCrop, Normalize, and tensor conversion
